ask: 25% off everything, Friday Nov 27 to Monday Nov 30, on acme.com/sale. Instagram and Facebook.
before: The user first asked for a Black Friday campaign. The one question asked was the offer and when it ends; this is the answer. Nothing else about the sale is known: no code, no stock limit.

arguments.name: Black Friday sale
arguments.theme: 25% off everything at Acme, Friday Nov 27 to Monday Nov 30
arguments.audience: People who follow Acme and buy gifts
arguments.context_notes: The offer: 25% off everything at acme.com/sale. It runs Friday Nov 27 to Monday Nov 30 only. Before Nov 27, say it is coming and when; never say it is live. Nothing after Nov 30. No codes, stock limits or countdown claims: none were given.

steps.why: Offer & Promotion only because a real discount and end date were given. One week, Tue Nov 24 to Mon Nov 30: three days of build-up, then the sale, never past its end. The strategy's own mix has a text post, which Instagram can't take, so the mix is sent without it: images and one carousel both fit Instagram and Facebook. The accounts and notes go on the same create call, so the campaign is made with them. The notes reach the writer word for word in the week's brief, so the real offer, dates and limits go here. The strategy already tells it never to invent urgency; the notes add what this sale does not have. Bolta spreads a week's posts over weekdays (or the brand's posting days), so no call puts a post on Saturday or Sunday: the user pins one under Post prompts on the campaign page.
Check before asking to start: starts_on not past, accounts set, resolved_content_mix as sent. Week 1 starts Tue Nov 24, so its drafts are written around Sun Nov 22.

say: Ready, not started: Black Friday sale for Acme, Offer & Promotion (the deal, its price, when it ends). Nov 24 to Nov 30 on Instagram and Facebook: 3 images and 1 carousel, 4 drafts to review, written around Sun Nov 22. The notes tell Bolta: teasers before Friday, the sale from Friday, nothing after Monday; check each draft's day when you review. Want a weekend post? Pin it under Post prompts at bolta.ai/dashboard/campaigns/<id>. Start it?
never: Inventing a discount, a code, a stock limit or "ends tonight" the user didn't give.
Running an offer campaign past the offer's end date.
A text post in a mix that goes to Instagram.
Promising which day each post lands: only the campaign page pins a post to a day.
